body.condition: Every complete latent density satisfies \(\lVert p_\theta^a\rVert_{C^k(\mathbb T^n)}\le K\).

novel.justification: A common \(C^k\) envelope rules out increasingly oscillatory complete laws that keep Hellinger error small while moving the inverse map at finer scales. Bounded trigonometric causal mechanisms on the compact torus satisfy the envelope for a fixed \(K\).
